The '''1949–50 Danish 1st Division''' season was the 5th edition of [[Danish 1st Division]] annual [[Association football|football]] competition in Denmark. It was contested by 10 teams.

[[Kjøbenhavns Boldklub]] successfully defended its [[1948-49 Danish 1st Division|1949 title]] in its successful pursuit of the 1950 title.

Statistics of [[Danish 1st Division]] in the 1949/1950 season.
